jobs.title: How Many Earths Fit in Each Planet?
jobs.description:
We filled every planet with Earths and counted. Mercury and Mars can't even hold one, but Jupiter swallows 1,321 Earths. And the Sun? About 1.3 million!

#planets #jupiter #space #science #shorts
